question: After the correctness and proof blockers are resolved, should the macOS app automatically offer this credential-import prompt after onboarding and make the imported profile the browser default on success?
rationale: The underlying import capability already exists, but adding an automatic post-onboarding credential prompt and changing the persisted browser default are user-facing policy choices that need explicit owner acceptance.

options.title: Accept the consent-first prompt
options.body: Land the local-only prompt and default mutation after the two defects are fixed and signed-app proof demonstrates the complete flow.

options.title: Settings-only import
options.body: Expose the import only through General Settings and avoid an automatic post-onboarding credential prompt.

options.title: Keep CLI and tool only
options.body: Do not add the native app surface and retain the already-merged lower-level import workflows.

recommendation.title: Accept the consent-first prompt
recommendation.body: Land the local-only prompt and default mutation after the two defects are fixed and signed-app proof demonstrates the complete flow.

likelyOwner.reason: His merged history introduced the underlying cookie-import capability and the central browser and macOS surfaces involved in this product choice.
